items.mainDefect: Hydration calls .map on null *_ids values, raising TypeError.

secondary.defect: Missing sideloaded records produce undefined entries in hydrated arrays, causing consumers to crash.

items.mainDefect: Failed sideload lookups produce undefined entries in hydrated arrays, causing consumers to crash.

secondary.defect: Globally consuming and replacing *_ids keys silently changes the shape of ordinary array attributes.

items.mainDefect: The migration crashes when the embed_category lookup returns no rows because it accesses the first row unconditionally.

secondary.defect: The uncategorized_category_id fallback also accesses the first row unconditionally and can crash when that setting has no row.

items.mainDefect: Host matching normalizes only the database column, so mixed-case URL hosts fail case-insensitive hostname matching.

secondary.defect: Validation permits stored hosts with ports, but lookup uses uri.host without the port, so those entries never match.

items.mainDefect: The context misspells embeddable as emeddable, causing correctly spelled name filters to skip its examples.

secondary.defect: The context fabricates an irrelevant embeddable host and misleadingly describes the examples as depending on its existence.

items.mainDefect: The migration crashes when the embed_category lookup returns no rows because it accesses the first row unconditionally.

secondary.defect: The uncategorized_category_id fallback also accesses the first row unconditionally and can crash when that setting has no row.
